curator_notes.summary: Read this suite as three linked families: a hydration pair, an osmotic trio, and a prestretch control. That ordering makes the biological story clearer than reading the runs alphabetically.

intro_text: This report compares completed runs side by side without baseline semantics. Treat the numerical differences as descriptive unless explicit tolerances were intended for this comparison.
